name: collector-react
description: React surface for the collector slice — routes, account screens, the TanStack-Query data layer (queryOptions reads + useMutation writes over an authed runner from router context), the per-slice client layer builder, runtime active-handler ref, and the sync runner that drives a CollectorBridgeMessageHandler from incoming sniffer events and persists parsed resources through each collector descriptor's injected `persistResource` sink (no FHIR write-switch — that moved into `fhir-r4-client-collector`). NOTE: the runner's requirement `R` is the union of every registered collector's write requirement, which the router context's authed runner must provide; today that union is `FhirR4ResourcesHttpApiClient`, so this slice still names it in `ExpectedClients` and depends on the FHIR R4 EMR slice (`fhir-r4`, `fhir-r4-react`, `fhir-r4-client-collector`) for that client layer and descriptor. The app wiring provides each collector's client layer. Documented as a deliberate slice-layering exception per slices/AGENTS.md.
